description: The product guide: every option the Studio has for one area, in the Studio's own words, generated from the same lists the editor uses (title designs, text, stickers, camera and timing, transitions, music styles and trimming, voices, photo edits and staging, branding, formats, plans) plus how_to_choose, which turns a wish like 'more modern', 'luxury feel' or 'calmer' into real settings. Read it before offering or describing options, and describe options only in its words.
